000010352003.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

000009493003.name: Close and Sanction
000009493003.description: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if the bearer was hit by one or more of those attacks, the bearer can make a Dash move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but it must finish that move as close as possible to the closest visible enemy unit. When doing so, it can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. The bearer can only make one Dash move per phase.

000010356003.name: The Ephemeral Tome
000010356003.description: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", and until the end of the turn, the bearer’s unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

000009777003.name: Radiant Champion
000009777003.description: Grey Knights Infantry model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and while the bearer is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, each time a melee attack made by the bearer scores a wound, the target of that attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage.

000010360003.name: Quickening Foci
000010360003.description: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. In your Movement phase, each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

000010348003.name: Blinding Aura
000010348003.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

000010364003.name: Shield of Prophecy
000010364003.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the battle round, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

000010348004.name: Purity of Purpose
000010348004.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

000010364004.name: A Foot in the Future
000010364004.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up in your Reinforcements step, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", and until the end of the turn, the bearer’s unit is not eligible to declare a Charge.

000010356004.name: The Sixty-sixth Seal
000010356004.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

000010360004.name: Sigil of Exigence
000010360004.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, in your opponent’s Shooting phase, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and then set it back up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the bearer’s unit is no longer an eligible target, your opponent can then select new targets for any attacks that had targeted the bearer’s unit.

000010352004.name: Sanctic Reaper
000010352004.description: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

000009777004.name: Phial of the Abyss
000009777004.description: Grey Knights Infantry model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

000010364005.name: Doomseer’s Amulet
000010364005.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up in your Reinforcements step, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

000010360005.name: Spiritus Machina
000010360005.description: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if the bearer’s unit disembarked from a Transport this turn, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

000009777005.name: Paragon of Sanctity
000009777005.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can select one friendly GREY KNIGHTS unit within 18" of and visible to it. If it does, until the end of the phase, that unit is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

000010356005.name: Pyresoul (Psychic)
000010356005.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the bearer; that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

000010348005.name: Tome of Forbidden Ways
000010348005.description: GREY KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Gate of Infinity rule.

000010352005.name: Nemesis Rounds
000010352005.description: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

000009537002.name: Celebrated Folk Hero
000009537002.description: The first time the bearer is destroyed, each enemy unit on the battlefield gains 1 Judgement token.

000010435002.name: Oathbound Speculator
000010435002.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

000010439002.name: Eye for Weakness
000010439002.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an assailed unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

000010443002.name: Dêlvwerke Navigator
000010443002.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Cthonian Beserks unit visible to the bearer and then spend any number of YP. Return one destroyed model to that unit and then, for every 2YP you just spent, return up to one additional destroyed model to that unit.

000010447002.name: Tactical Alchemy
000010447002.description: Kâhl model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer’s unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control that are not within your deployment zone, you can spend 1YP. If you do, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

000010451002.name: Fârstrydr Node
000010451002.description: Iron-master or Memnyr Strategist model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability.

000010708002.name: Mercenary Prospector
000010708002.description: Kâhl model only. Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by the bearer’s unit, gain 2YP.

000009823002.name: Bastion Shield
000009823002.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the attacking model is within 12" of the bearer’s unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spend 1YP, until the end of the phase, if the attacking model is within 18" of the bearer’s unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 instead.

000009529002.name: Masterful Construction
000009529002.description: Each time the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, you can select one of the following weapon abilities: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]; [LETHAL HITS]; [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by the bearer (excluding Psychic weapons) have that ability.

000009537003.name: Gûlyk’s Stars
000009537003.description: Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. If this results in one or more enemy models being destroyed, you can select one closed Hatchway within 6" of the bearer and open it.

000010443003.name: Multiwave System Jammer
000010443003.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per battle, in your Movement phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Cthonian unit that is in Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

000010451003.name: Calculated Tenacity
000010451003.description: Iron-master or Memnyr Strategist model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

000010708003.name: Metaphysical Brokerage
000010708003.description: Memnyr Strategist model only. At the end of your turn, if the bearer is on the battlefield and you gained fewer than 3YP this turn, you gain an amount of YP equal to the difference.

000010439003.name: Writ of Acquisition
000010439003.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, you gain 1YP for each assailed enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (to a maximum of 3YP).

000010447003.name: Trivärg Cyber Implant
000010447003.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, or if you spend 2YP, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [sustained HITS 2] ability.

000009823003.name: Quake Multigenerator
000009823003.description: Kâhl model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

000010435003.name: Dead Reckoning
000010435003.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. At the end of the turn, if the bearer is on the battlefield and you spent no YP in that turn, you can gain 1YP.

000009529003.name: Obsessive Drive
000009529003.description: At the start of the first battle round, select one objective marker. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, each enemy unit within range of that objective marker is considered to have 1 additional Judgement token while resolving those attacks.

000010451004.name: Mantle of Elders
000010451004.description: Memnyr Strategist model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if you spend YP using the Optimal Application Detachment rule when doing so, you can roll one D6: on a 2+, you gain 1YP.

000010708004.name: Etacarn SB9 Targeting Implant
000010708004.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

000010443004.name: Quake Supervisor
000010443004.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Leagues of Votann Artillery units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ARTILLERY units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, add 1 to the Hit roll.

000010439004.name: Surgical Saboteur
000010439004.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, select one MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks; until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned.

000010435004.name: Iron Ambassador
000010435004.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model equipped with an Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only. Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend up to 3YP and, until the end of the phase, add the number of YP you just spent to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s ranged weapons.

000010447004.name: Precursive Judgement
000010447004.description: Kâhl model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly Leagues of Votann Transport units, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP and hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

000009823004.name: Ironskein
000009823004.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

000010439005.name: Nomad Strategist
000010439005.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend up to 4YP. Select one Hernkyn unit from your army, and, for every 2YP you just spent, select up to one additional HERNKYN unit from your army. You can remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding assailed units).

000010443005.name: Piledriver
000010443005.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to fight, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend up to 2YP and, until the end of the phase, add the number of YP you just spent to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

000010447005.name: Signature Restoration
000010447005.description: Iron-master model only. Each time a friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN model is repaired using the bearer’s Forgewrought Expertise ability, that model regains 1 additional lost wound.

000010451005.name: Graviton Vault
000010451005.description: Iron-master model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, and in the Fight phase, after the bearer has fought, select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

000010435005.name: Ancestral Crest
000010435005.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per turn, when you target the bearer’s unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend 1YP and reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

000009823005.name: High Kâhl
000009823005.description: Kâhl model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

000010708005.name: Asset Manipulator
000010708005.description: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. At the start of the Command phase, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the turn, while an enemy unit is within 3" of the bearer, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

000008550002.name: Honourable Combatant
000008550002.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

000008372002.name: Veil of Darkness
000008372002.description: NECRONS model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove that unit from the battlefield. Then, in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

000009596002.name: Inured to Damage
000009596002.description: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. Once the bearer has destroyed one or more enemy units, it has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

000008546002.name: Dimensional Sanctum
000008546002.description: CRYPTEK model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Infiltrators ability.

000008543002.name: Eternal Madness
000008543002.description: NECRONS model only. In the Fight phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking models unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

000010664002.name: Quantum Abacus
000010664002.description: NECRONS model only. Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is within range of one or more objectives: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

000009604002.name: Nanoscarab Reconstitution
000009604002.description: In each player’s Command phase, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

000010668002.name: Destroyer Ankh
000010668002.description: Catacomb Command Barge or Overlord model only. The bearer has the Destroyer Cult keyword. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

000009588002.name: Resurrection Protocols
000009588002.description: The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D3 wounds remaining.

000010735002.name: Cryptometric Experimentation
000010735002.description: Add 1 to the Toughness and Wounds characteristics of the bearer. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

000010672002.name: Singularity Matrix
000010672002.description:
C’tan Shard of the Deceiver model only. This model has the following ability:

Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

000008554002.name: Dimensional Overseer
000008554002.description: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add one to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Hyperphasing rule.

000009749002.name: Dread Majesty (Aura)
000009749002.description: Overlord or Catacomb Command Barge model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

000008546003.name: Hyperphasic Fulcrum
000008546003.description: CRYPTEK model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, if that unit is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

000009604003.name: Impromptu Translocation
000009604003.description: Once per battle, after the bearer has shot, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

000008543003.name: Ingrained Superiority
000008543003.description: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

000009596003.name: Domineering Presence
000009596003.description: In your opponent’s Command phase, at the start of the Battle-shock step, select one enemy unit within 3" of the bearer; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

000009749003.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope
000009749003.description: NECRONS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

000008550003.name: Unflinching Will
000008550003.description: OVERLORD model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] abilities.

000008554003.name: Arisen Tyrant
000008554003.description: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the bearer’s unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

000010672003.name: Quantum Goad
000010672003.description: C’tan Shard of the Nightbringer model only. This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

000010668003.name: Murdermind
000010668003.description: Cryptek model only. The bearer has the Destroyer Cult keyword and during the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a DESTROYER CULT unit (excluding CHARACTER units). If you do, the bearer’s unit cannot contain any models without the DESTROYER CULT keyword. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

000010735003.name: Portal Transmuter
000010735003.description: Once per turn, when the bearer ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 3" of an open Hatchway or when the bearer opens a Hatchway, it can, before any units decide if they wish to fire Overwatch, use this ability. If it does, remove the bearer from the battlefield and set it back up on the battlefield wholly within 3" of another open Hatchway and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. When doing so, if the bearer cannot be set back up on the battlefield, it is destroyed.

000010664003.name: Atomic Disintegrators
000010664003.description: Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can also select from the following abilities: [ANTI-MONSTER 5+], [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+].

000008372003.name: Nether-realm Casket
000008372003.description: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

000009588003.name: Mindshackle Scarabs
000009588003.description: CRYPTEK model only. In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

000008546004.name: Autodivinator
000008546004.description: CRYPTEK model only. Each time your opponent gains a CP as the result of an ability, roll one D6: on a 2+, you also gain 1CP.

000008543004.name: Soulless Reaper
000008543004.description: DESTROYER CULT model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6: on a 3+, that unit cannot Fall Back this phase and must Remain Stationary.

000009749004.name: Demanding Leader
000009749004.description: NECRONS model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

000010672004.name: Animus Damper
000010672004.description: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon model only. Once per turn, at the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if that Leadership test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

000008550004.name: Warrior Noble
000008550004.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

000010668004.name: Mark of the Nekrosor
000010668004.description: Destroyer Cult model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

000008554004.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
000008554004.description: NECRONS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

000010664004.name: Gauntlet of Compression
000010664004.description: NECRONS model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

000008372004.name: Phasal Subjugator (Aura)
000008372004.description: NECRONS model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding CHARACTER units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

000010668005.name: Cursed Circlet
000010668005.description: Destroyer Cult model only. Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from the bearer’s unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, the bearer’s unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer’s unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but the bearer’s unit must finish that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. A unit cannot make a Surge move while it is Battle-shocked.

000008543005.name: Eldritch Nightmare
000008543005.description: DESTROYER CULT model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

000008550005.name: Eternal Conqueror
000008550005.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

000008546005.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
000008546005.description: CRYPTEK model only. Once per phase, when an enemy unit selects the bearer’s unit as a target of a charge, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

000008554005.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
000008554005.description: NECRONS model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability.

000010672005.name: Reletavistic Tether
000010672005.description: Transcendent C’tan model only. In your turn, each time this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike or Transdimensional Displacement abilities, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if this model is set up within 9" of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

000010664005.name: Gravitic Bolas
000010664005.description: Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding TITANIC units); until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

000008372005.name: Enaegic Dermal Bond
000008372005.description: NECRONS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

000009749005.name: Chrono-impedance Fields
000009749005.description: NECRONS model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

000009623002.name: Tellyporta
000009623002.description: In the Deploy Armies step, select one MEGANObz unit from your army. Until the end of the battle, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

000009795002.name: Skwad Leader
000009795002.description: Warboss Infantry model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Kommandos unit. While leading a Kommandos unit, it has the Infiltrators and Stealth abilities.

000010799002.name: Runnin’ Boots
000010799002.description: Orks Infantry Character model only. Each time you make a Charge roll for the bearer’s unit, if that unit disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to the result.

000008877002.name: Gitfinder Googlez
000008877002.description: Mek model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability.

000008872002.name: Fasta Than Yooz
000008872002.description: Orks Infantry model only. Each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT after that TRANSPORT has made a Normal move, the bearer’s unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

000009615002.name: Living Battering Ram
000009615002.description: Each time the bearer attempts to operate a closed Hatchway, your opponent cannot try to prevent it. In addition, each time the bearer opens a Hatchway, each enemy unit within 6" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

000010712002.name: Da Kaptin
000010712002.description: Warboss model only. Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly ORKS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of the bearer. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and it is no longer Battle-shocked.

000008868002.name: Glory Hog
000008868002.description: Beastboss on Squigosaur model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

000010795002.name: Kustom Shokk Box
000010795002.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. Each time the bearer uses its turbo, its unit can move horizontally through terrain features.

000008881002.name: Bloodthirsty Belligerence
000008881002.description: Orks Infantry model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit. While that unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit as well.

000009991002.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
000009991002.description: ORKS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities.

000008367002.name: Follow Me Ladz
000008367002.description: ORKS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

000008885002.name: Big Gob
000008885002.description: Infantry Warboss model only. At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement range of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, and when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.

000008868003.name: Proper Killy
000008868003.description: Beast Snagga model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

000010712003.name: Git-spotter Squig
000010712003.description: ORKS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

000010799003.name: Blitzkaptin
000010799003.description: Orks Character model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer’s unit (or any Transport it is embarked within) is on the battlefield, select up to three Orks Vehicle units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

000009623003.name: Gnasher Squig Crates
000009623003.description: WARbOSS model only. In your Command phase, you can select one NObz or MEGANObz unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) that is within 6" of the bearer and is within range of an objective marker. If there are no enemy models within range of that objective marker, it is Secured by your army.

000008872003.name: Speed Makes Right
000008872003.description: Orks model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer (or a TRANSPORT the bearer is embarked within) is within 9" of one or more enemy units, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1CP.

000009615003.name: Scarred Brute
000009615003.description: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

000010795003.name: Dakkamek
000010795003.description: Mek model only. Each time the bearer uses its Mekaniak ability, until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by the selected Vehicle model have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.

000009795003.name: Mek Kaptin
000009795003.description: Big Mek, Big Mek in Mega Armour or Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Flash Gitz unit. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

000009991003.name: Dead Shiny Shootas
000009991003.description: ORKS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.

000008367003.name: Headwoppa’s Killchoppa
000008367003.description: ORKS model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

000008881003.name: Brutal But Kunnin’
000008881003.description: Orks Infantry model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or is embarked within a TRANSPORT that is on the battlefield), roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if the bearer’s unit contains 10 or more models: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

000008877003.name: Press It Fasta!
000008877003.description: Mek model only. Each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, when rolling to determine which ability that unit’s weapons gain from the Try Dat Button! Detachment rule, roll one additional D6: until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit gain both Button Effects generated by those rolls. If a duplicate Button Effect is rolled, it has no additional effect.

000008885003.name: Da Biggest Boss
000008885003.description: Infantry Warboss model only. Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

000010795004.name: Supa-burny Fuel
000010795004.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. Change the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s killa jet – burna weapon to 3D6, and change the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s killa jet – cutta weapon to 3.

000010799004.name: Supercharged Squig Oil
000010799004.description: Mek model only. Each time the bearer uses its Mekaniak ability, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls for the selected VEHICLE model’s unit.

000010712004.name: Bionik Workshop
000010712004.description:
Big Mek or Painboy model only. At the start of the battle, roll one D3 and compare the result to the list below. Until the end of the battle, models in the bearer’s unit have that bioniks ability.

• Bionik Legs: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this model.

• Bionik Arms: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

• Bionik Bonce: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.

000009991004.name: Targetin’ Squigs
000009991004.description: ORKS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

000009795004.name: Mork’s Kunnin’
000009795004.description: ORKS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ORKS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

000008367004.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal
000008367004.description: ORKS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

000008872004.name: Squig-hide Tyres
000008872004.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

000008868004.name: Skrag Every Stash!
000008868004.description: Beast Snagga model only. At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

000008885004.name: ’Eadstompa
000008885004.description: Infantry Warboss model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

000008881004.name: Ferocious Show Off
000008881004.description: Orks Infantry model only. Each time the bearer fights, while resolving those attacks, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of the bearers melee weapons. If the bearer’s unit contains 10 or more models, while resolving those attacks, add 3 to the Strength characteristic instead.

000008877004.name: Smoky Gubbinz
000008877004.description: Mek model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

000008881005.name: Raucous Warcaller
000008881005.description: Orks Infantry model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit always counts as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule and any Stratagems you use.

000008877005.name: Supa-glowy Fing
000008877005.description: Mek model only. In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to the bearer, then roll one D6: on a 1-2, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; on a 3-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5-6, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

000010799005.name: Tuff Git
000010799005.description: Orks Infantry Character model only. At the end of a phase in which the bearer’s unit disembarked from a Transport, if that unit is Battle-shocked, it is no longer Battle-shocked.

000010795005.name: Master Meknologist
000010795005.description: Big Mek model only. Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of the bearer’s ranged weapons by 1.

000009991005.name: Zog Off and Eat Dakka!
000009991005.description: ORKS model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

000008868005.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
000008868005.description: Beastboss on Squigosaur model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

000010712005.name: Razgit’s Magik Map
000010712005.description: ORKS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Orks Infantry units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

000009795005.name: Gob Boomer
000009795005.description: Warboss or Mek model only. Each time the bearer issues Taktiks, it can do so to a friendly Orks Infantry or Orks Mounted unit within 18", instead of 6".

000008367005.name: Supa-Cybork Body
000008367005.description: ORKS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

000008885005.name: Tellyporta
000008885005.description: Warboss in Mega Armour model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability.

000008872005.name: Wazblasta
000008872005.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

000010493002.name: Bearer of the Iron Chalice
000010493002.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That selected model regains up to D3 lost wounds, or up to 3 lost wounds if your army is Honoured.

000010755002.name: Bringer of Justice
000010755002.description: Imperial Knights model only. Improve the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

000009761002.name: Omnissian Champion
000009761002.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Add 4 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

000010506002.name: Mentor’s Pride
000010506002.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearers Bondsman ability, each time each of those ARMIGER models makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

000010502002.name: Herald of Triumph
000010502002.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer ends a Charge move, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

000010497002.name: Acquisitor-at-Arms
000010497002.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is on your defensive line and there are no enemy units on your defensive line, add the bearers Objective Control characteristic to that of each model affected by the bearers Bondsman ability.

000010755003.name: Hunter’s Eye
000010755003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

000010493003.name: Bearer of the Evanescent Ion
000010493003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that selected model has the Stealth ability.

000010506003.name: Fables of Nightmare
000010506003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, melee weapons equipped by those ARMIGER models have the [precision] ability.

000010502003.name: Wyrmslayer Divination
000010502003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack that targets a unit that can FLY, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

000009761003.name: Knight of the Opus Machina
000009761003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, if the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly Adeptus Mechanicus units, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

000010497003.name: Purgation’s Hand
000010497003.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is on your defensive line, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

000010755004.name: Mysterious Guardian
000010755004.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your subsequent Movement phase, set the bearer up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the battle ends and the bearer is not on the battlefield, it is destroyed.

000010493004.name: Bearer of the Judicant’s Helm
000010493004.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by that selected model have the [ignores cover] ability.

000010506004.name: Tales of Heroism
000010506004.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, each time one of those ARMIGER models makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and/or the Wound roll.

000009761004.name: Magos Questoris
000009761004.description: Tech-Priest model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Imperial Knights units, it has the Lone Operative ability. In your Command phase, select one friendly Imperial Knights model within 3" of the bearer. That model regains up to 2 lost wounds.

000010502004.name: Pennant of Silvered Fury
000010502004.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [sustained hits 2] ability.

000010497004.name: Augury Halo
000010497004.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, while the bearer is on your defensive line, weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ignores cover] ability.

000010755005.name: Sanctuary
000010755005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.

000010506005.name: Martial Tuition
000010506005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models arc under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, once per turn, you can target one of those ARMIGER models with the Counter-offensive Stratagem for 0CP.

000010493005.name: Bearer of the Lancer’s Sigil
000010493005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that selected model.

000009761005.name: Vocifer Magnificat (Aura)
000009761005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. While a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit is within 6" of the bearer, improve the Leadership characteristic of models in that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit by 1.

000010502005.name: Crushing Condemnation
000010502005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

000010497005.name: Vengeful Tread
000010497005.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, you can target the bearer with the Tank Shock Stratagem for 0CP.

000010312002.name: Preyslayer’s Mantle
000010312002.description: War Dog model only. The bearer has the Super-heavy Walker ability.

000009765002.name: Profane Altar
000009765002.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a Dark Sacrifice, the maximum number of models are destroyed in the selected Damned unit (i.e. 3 if the unit’s Leadership test is passed, or 6 if it is failed) but, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s weapons have both [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

000010304002.name: Knight Diabolus
000010304002.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the [LANCE] ability.

000010308002.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
000010308002.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

000010751002.name: Aspect of the Beast
000010751002.description: Chaos Knights model only. At the start of your Command phase, select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army

000008516002.name: Nightmare’s Master
000008516002.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

000010308003.name: Blade of Celerity
000010308003.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

000009765003.name: Pave the Way
000009765003.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three Damned units from your army. The selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

000010312003.name: Final Howl (Aura)
000010312003.description: War Dog model only. While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

000008516003.name: Tyrant’s Shadow
000008516003.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is within range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army.

000010751003.name: Hunter’s Helm
000010751003.description: Chaos Knights model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

000010304003.name: Blasphemous Engine
000010304003.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Malefic Surge, you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds.

000010751004.name: Octagram of Conjuration
000010751004.description:
Knight Abominant model only. The bearer has the following ability:

Octagram of Conjuration (Aura): While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, after that WAR DOG model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

000010312004.name: Loping Predator
000010312004.description: War Dog model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [assault] ability.

000010304004.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
000010304004.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

000009765004.name: Tyrant’s Banner
000009765004.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a Dark Sacrifice, select one visible friendly Damned unit to take a Leadership test instead of a friendly DAMNED unit within 6".

000008516004.name: Malevolent Heraldry
000008516004.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

000010308004.name: Warp-borne Stalker
000010308004.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

000010304005.name: Bestial Aspect
000010304005.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [assault] ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

000009765005.name: Diabolical Resilience
000009765005.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to any Advance or Charge rolls made for it.

000008516005.name: Veil of Medrengard
000008516005.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

000010312005.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knight
000010312005.description: War Dog model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

000010751005.name: Throne Tyrannicus
000010751005.description: Titanic Chaos Knights model only. In your Command phase, select one other Chaos Knights Character model within 9" of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly War Dog units, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER model is affected by those Aura abilities as well.

000010308005.name: Putrid Carapace
000010308005.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

000010308006.name: Mirror of Fates
000010308006.description:
CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if another unit from your army has already been targeted by that Stratagem this phase. In addition, you gain Lord of Deceit ability:

Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

000010308007.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
000010308007.description: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

000010676002.name: Eye of the Primarch
000010676002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer and Battleline models in the bearer’s unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

000009851002.name: Wolves’ Wisdom
000009851002.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. The bearer’s unit can declare a charge against one or more units within 6" instead of within 3" when using The Great Wolf Watches Detachment rule.

000009785002.name: Prescience
000009785002.description: Adeptus Astartes Psyker model only (excluding Terminator models). Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of the bearer’s unit, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if the Divination Discipline is active for your army.

000008774002.name: Champion of the Deathwing
000008774002.description: Deathwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [lethal hits] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

000008490002.name: The Blade Driven Deep
000008490002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

000010684002.name: Seals of Reconquest
000010684002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

000008494002.name: The Imperium’s Sword
000008494002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearers melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

000010680002.name: Laurels of Thunder
000010680002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit in a turn in which it was set up on the battlefield.

000010368002.name: Immolator
000010368002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of Torrent weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

000010396002.name: Imperialis of the Eternal Crusade
000010396002.description: Ancient model only. Each time an enemy unit selects the bearer’s unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any olher negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

000008522002.name: Thief of Secrets
000008522002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. At the end of the Fight phase, if one or more enemy models were destroyed as a result of a melee attack made by the bearer this phase, until the end of the battle, improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

000010392002.name: Incendiary Animus
000010392002.description: Chaplain or Judiciar model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit by 1.

000010155002.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
000010155002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for that unit.

000010269002.name: Wolf-touched
000010269002.description: Space Wolves model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of the bearer. In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Wulfen Infantry unit.

000008771002.name: Shroud of Heroes
000008771002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining (if the bearer was Battle-shocked when it was destroyed, it is instead returned with its full wounds remaining).

000010400002.name: Paragon of Fury
000010400002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time a melee attack made by the bearer is allocated to an enemy model, if the bearer disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

000008482002.name: Champion of Humanity
000008482002.description: TACTICUS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for them (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

000010660002.name: Grimnar’s Mark
000010660002.description:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. Once per battle round, from the second battle round onwards, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.

In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Wolf Guard Terminators unit.

000010265002.name: Braggart’s Steel
000010265002.description: Space Wolves model only. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. If the bearer’s unit has achieved one or more Boasts, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons as well.

000010645002.name: Carmine Reliquary
000010645002.description: Chaplain model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability. Each time you take a Battle-shock test for an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll the result.

000010261002.name: Swift Hunter
000010261002.description: Space Wolves model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 7" ability.

000009190002.name: Artisan of War
000009190002.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearers weapons by 1, and the bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+.

000009843002.name: Pyrebrand
000009843002.description: Black Templars model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

000008486002.name: Fury of the Storm
000008486002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearers melee weapons by 2 instead.

000008478002.name: Target Augury Web
000008478002.description: Techmarine model only. In your Command phase, select one Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, weapons equipped by that VEHICLE model have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

000010633002.name: Armour of Antoninus
000010633002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

000008778002.name: Master-crafted Weapon
000008778002.description: Ravenwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] ability.

000008474002.name: Indomitable Fury
000008474002.description: GRAVIS model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

000009248002.name: Omni-Structural Auspex
000009248002.description: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model (excluding Character models) makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

000008353002.name: Artificer Armour
000008353002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

000010783002.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
000010783002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save and, at the end of your Command phase, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

000010779002.name: Liberator
000010779002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase, and the bearer’s unit (or any Heavy Transport it is embarked within) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

000010727002.name: Speartip of the Chapter
000010727002.description: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit and up to one other friendly unit within the same Entry Zone can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

000010759002.name: Honour Indefatigable
000010759002.description: Gravis model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

000009733002.name: Calibanite Armaments
000009733002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

000009240002.name: Adamantine Mantle
000009240002.description: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

000009255002.name: Seal of Indomitability
000009255002.description: Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

000010629002.name: Spearpoint Paragon
000010629002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

000009835002.name: Prescient Flash
000009835002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

000010466002.name: Blackwing Shroud
000010466002.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

000010460002.name: Champion of the Feast
000010460002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

000008376002.name: Speed of the Primarch
000008376002.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

000010623002.name: Spiritus Ferrum
000010623002.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

000009186002.name: Sanguinius’ Grace
000009186002.description: Death Company model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, the bearer can fight one additional time.

000010660003.name: Howlmaw
000010660003.description: Wolf priest model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock, subtracting 1 from the result.

000010676003.name: Hero of the Chapter
000010676003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, the bearer has the Battleline keyword.

000010680003.name: Veteran of the Vanguard
000010680003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

000010684003.name: Avenging Avatar (Aura)
000010684003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

000008486003.name: Portents of Wisdom
000008486003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

000010759003.name: Castellum Omnivox
000010759003.description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Fall Back move, select one of the following to apply to that unit until the end of the turn:

• That unit is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Fell Back.

• That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

000010779003.name: Tip of the Spear
000010779003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Transport, that TRANSPORT has the Scouts 6" ability.

000010783003.name: Gunnery Honours
000010783003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model only. Once per phase, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll for the bearer.

000009835003.name: Troubling Visions
000009835003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. When it does, until the start of your next Command phase, all Angelic Legacy abilities are active for the bearer’s unit, instead of only two of them.

000008353003.name: The Honour Vehement
000008353003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearers melee weapons instead.

000008771003.name: Stubborn Tenacity
000008771003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength.

000010727003.name: Tolorek Data Djinn
000010727003.description: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

000008778003.name: Mounted Strategist
000008778003.description: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

000008376003.name: Rage-fuelled Warrior
000008376003.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearers melee weapons have the [sustained hits 3] ability.

000008522003.name: Osseus Key
000008522003.description: Watch Master or Techmarine model only. At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

000010261003.name: Fenrisian Grit
000010261003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

000010265003.name: Skjald
000010265003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time a Space Wolves Character unit from your army achieves a Boast, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

000010269003.name: Hunter’s Guile
000010269003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Thunderwolf Cavalry, Wulfen and/or Blood Claws units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

000009255003.name: Resolute
000009255003.description: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed, and each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

000008774003.name: Eye of the Unseen
000008774003.description: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+, you gain 1CP

000009851003.name: Foes’ Fate
000009851003.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

000009190003.name: Visage of Death
000009190003.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponents Command phase, each enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

000008482003.name: War-tempered Artifice
000008482003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

000009843003.name: Sacred Rage
000009843003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

000010396003.name: Consecrating Aura
000010396003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

000009733003.name: Lord of the Hunt
000009733003.description: Ravenwing model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for models in the bearer’s unit.

000009785003.name: Celerity
000009785003.description: Adeptus Astartes Psyker model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced, and if the Biomancy Discipline is active for your army, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

000010155003.name: Ancient Weapons
000010155003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

000008494003.name: Fear Made Manifest (Aura)
000008494003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by its controlling player). Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

000008490003.name: Ghostweave Cloak
000008490003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

000009186003.name: Blood Shard
000009186003.description: Death Company model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

000008478003.name: The Flesh is Weak
000008478003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

000010368003.name: War-tempered Artifice
000010368003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

000010400003.name: Battle-psalm Precentor
000010400003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Shock and Awe Detachment rule, subtract 1 from that Battle-shock test.

000010392003.name: Oathbound Exemplar
000010392003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 1 to Advance rolls made for the bearer’s unit. If the mission pack you are playing features Actions, the bearer’s unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

000009248003.name: Void Warrior
000009248003.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

000009240003.name: Clavitine Reliquary
000009240003.description: In your Movement phase, each time the bearer is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, if it is within 1" of a Hatchway, it can attempt to operate that Hatchway. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

000010460003.name: Disciple of Rhetoricus
000010460003.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

000010466003.name: Coronal Susurrant
000010466003.description:
Phobos model only. The bearer has the following ability:

Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

000008474003.name: Fleet Commander
000008474003.description: CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one point on the battlefield and place a marker on that point. At the start of your next Shooting phase, place another marker on the battlefield within 12" of the centre of the first marker, then draw a straight line between the centre of each of these markers. Roll one D6 for each unit that line passes over or through: on a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Both markers are then removed.

000010623003.name: Medusan Roar (Aura)
000010623003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by its controlling player). Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

000010629003.name: Stormseers’ Wisdom
000010629003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

000010633003.name: Oath of Macragge
000010633003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

000010645003.name: Master of the Red Thirst
000010645003.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

000008778004.name: Master of Manoeuvre
000008778004.description: Ravenwing model only. If the bearer’s unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

000008353004.name: Adept of the Codex
000008353004.description: CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, instead of selecting a Combat Doctrine to be active for your army, you can select the Tactical Doctrine.
